# Illumia Solutions

> Enterprise-grade cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, open-source, and custom software development for businesses in India, the USA, Australia, and beyond. Certified Proxmox Silver Partner.

Illumia Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is based in Kolkata, India, and serves clients globally with 24/7 support across multiple time zones. Team holds CISA, CISSP, CEH, and CCIE certifications with 20+ years of collective industry experience.

## Key Facts

- Headquarters: 98/9 Gopal Lal Tagore Rd, Baranagar, Kolkata, West Bengal 700036, India
- Areas served: India, United States, Philippines, Australia, Kenya, Mozambique
- Certifications: Proxmox Silver Partner; team holds CISA, CISSP, CEH, CCIE
- Full page list: [llms-full.txt](https://illumiasolutions.com/llms-full.txt)
